name: Thereza Henrik
source:
Blue Princess.
A young princess with black hair and blue eyes.
Having only known the winter season, she longs for the arrival of the "blue season (summer)."
Because she is pure and innocent, she can be a bit harsh.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040202001505/http://www.cherrysoft.co.jp/cherrysoft/kyrie.htm]the official site[/url]]
